title: UI Colors (requires restart after making changes)
Divider bar color
desc: Color of the thin horizontal lines at top and bottom of panel. Default is ff8000 (orange)

title: Icon background color
desc: Background color for (unselected) icons and panel tabs. Default is 0d0d09 (dark brown)

title: Icon foreground color
desc: Foreground color of (unselected) icons and panel tabs. Default is ff8000 (orange).

title: Canvas background color
desc: The overall background color of the panel. Default is 000000 (black).

title: Table heading background color
desc: Background color of table headings.  Default is ff8000 (orange)

title: Table heading foreground color
desc: Foreground color of table headings. Default is 000000 (black)

title: Panel title text color
desc: Color of the panel name text. Default is ffffff (white)

title: Captions text color
desc: Color of the any captions / directions under the panel title. Default is ffffff (white)

title: Panel text color
desc: Normal color of standard text on a display panel. Default is ffffff (white)

title: Lowlight color
desc: Lowlighted text on a display panel. Default is bfbfbf (Grey)

title: Highlight color 1
desc: Highlighted text on a display panel. Default is ffffb2 (pale yellow)

title: Highlight color 2
desc: Highlighted text on a display panel. Default is 00aaff (blue)

title: Warning color
desc: Color of warning text. Default is fc4c02 (orange-red)

title: Last spoken text color
desc: Color of text in the Last Spoken box at the bottom of the UI. Default is ffffb2 (green)
